review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked its one new data-carrying definition, `localizedTwoBlockParameterMul`, against Mathlib's `AddMonoidHom.mulLeft` in Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Basic.lean. I also grepped the lean-pool sources for uses of the definition. It occurs only in this file, at its own `@[simp]` apply lemma and in the ker/range theorem. The other declarations are theorems about the file's own constructions, so they are out of scope for this rubric. I judge the finding to be low-to-moderate severity. The main argument against it is that the name documents the intent.

toFun y :=

findings.problem: This re-defines left multiplication by a fixed ring element as a bundled `→+` map, with the same `toFun`, `map_zero'` (`mul_zero`) and `map_add'` (`mul_add`) fields. Mathlib already has this concept as `AddMonoidHom.mulLeft r : R →+ R`, with `toFun a := r * a`. The file adds a private-style copy plus its own `_apply` simp lemma, so the range statement is phrased with a local object. Mathlib's `mulLeft_apply`/`coe_mulLeft` lemmas and its `mulLeft_eq_mulRight_iff_forall_commute` do not apply to this object until it is unfolded. The definition is used only in the ker/range corollary at line 175, so no other API depends on the local name.
findings.proposed_change: Delete `localizedTwoBlockParameterMul` and `localizedTwoBlockParameterMul_apply`. State the corollary with `AddMonoidHom.range (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft ((localizedTwoBlockIdeal D S q).ringCon.mk' (OreLocalization.numeratorRingHom (MulOpposite.op D.c))))`. If a name for the parameter class is wanted, introduce an `abbrev` or `local notation` for the element itself. The existing proof of the ker/range corollary should go through, since `AddMonoidHom.mem_range` unfolds to the same `∃ y, c * y = z`.
findings.benefit: This removes a duplicate bundled left-multiplication map and its simp lemma. Readers see the standard Mathlib `AddMonoidHom.mulLeft` and get its lemma set for free. The file also has fewer private declarations to maintain.
